Data definitions & coverage

Report weeks are centred on Sunday and use the venue’s local kickoff date. Friday–Monday fixtures share that Sunday’s ISO week number; Monday belongs to the preceding Sunday. Tuesday–Thursday midweek matches belong to the upcoming Sunday. Kickoff times also appear in JST for viewing. Verified match records cover domestic leagues plus Champions League and Europa League for players confirmed on the UEFA competition squad (List A or List B). Registered players retain previews and team scores even when unused or outside the matchday squad. Unconfirmed registration is excluded. UEFA registration evidence starts on its source check date; earlier participation is not inferred. Completed matches are automatically refreshed from FotMob after final time. Source gaps keep the last verified snapshot; missing match statistics remain unknown. Source CSVs and daily workbook sheets retain their original publication grouping; the weekly CSV download uses this report’s grouping.

The watchlist covers first-team players and academy players called into first-team match squads. A player missing from a published lineup is “Not in match squad”; absence reasons are not inferred. “No record yet” means no verified match record is available, not zero appearances.

Apps, minutes, goals and assists in Player Summary are current domestic league season totals for the listed club, sourced from FotMob with Sofascore as an independently labelled fallback. They do not change with the report week. Partial data remains blank rather than being assumed zero; rated-match count is not used as the appearance count. The appearance/contribution filters and minute/contribution sorting use season totals. The top summary cards, match cards and weekly FotMob ratings still follow the selected report week. Weekly ratings are FotMob match ratings out of 10. The separate Sofascore season column shows the published average for the listed domestic league and season, independent of the selected report week. Calendar-year leagues use their current calendar season. No prior-season, cup or other-provider ratings are substituted. Each season rating includes its rated-match count and source check date. Weekly ratings are the unweighted mean of available FotMob ratings; the rated-match count is shown. Missing ratings and statistics stay blank. Own goals never count toward player goals. All links point to the supporting match or roster evidence.

Roster checks pending / not included in counts:

    Leagues without source-confirmed players are hidden from the filters. Some leagues have no published player lineup or rating data for W41. Their missing values remain blank.

    Updates are checked at 08:00 JST on Saturday, Sunday, Monday and Tuesday after European Friday–Monday fixtures. Days without new or corrected verified data are skipped.
